notes: Corrected twice: בְּתוֹכָהּ → *were in it* now fuses בְּ+תוֹךְ to *were in* under rule 30 with the copula on that unit (rule 49); and *themselves* moves from the passive verb to the suffix of לְבַדָּם, which is the 3mp morpheme that licenses it (rule 18).
*neither … nor* is split between the written לֹא and the waw, as rule 14 directs when a present negative can carry the opening correlative.
Unlike EZK.14.16, the ASV writes a second English word for לְבַדָּם here, so rule 2 splits the expression instead of fusing all three morphemes.
